title: Global regular functions on an algebraic space and canonical pullback
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Define $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ as the commutative ring of families $s_{T,a}\in\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ for every $S$-scheme $T$ and map $a:h_T\to X$, compatible with pullback along every scheme morphism over $X$, with componentwise operations. For $f:X\to Y$, define $f^*(s)_{T,a}=s_{T,f\circ a}$, where $f\circ a$ denotes the composite $h_T\xrightarrow{a}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$. These maps give the contravariant global-functions functor. Restriction of such a family to the small etale site is bijective onto the compatible sections of the specified small etale structure sheaf, so this is its ring of global sections.
